Control account — Special Accounts

Configure the control account for special accounts.

This account tracks balances for all special account sub-accounts.

Name

Enter the name of the control account. This name will appear on financial reports instead of individual special account names.

Code

Optionally, enter an account code. Codes help organize accounts and can be used for searching and sorting.

Group

Select the balance sheet group where this control account should appear. This determines its placement on the balance sheet.

Cash Flow Statement

Select the cash flow statement category for this control account. This determines how cash flows are classified.

CashFlowStatementOperatingActivityGroup

Select the operating activities group if the cash flow statement category is set to Operating Activities.

CashFlowStatementFinancingActivityGroup

Select the financing activities group if the cash flow statement category is set to Financing Activities.

CashFlowStatementInvestingActivityGroup

Select the investing activities group if the cash flow statement category is set to Investing Activities.

Position

Set the position number to control the display order within the selected group. Lower numbers appear first.

Inactive

Mark this control account as inactive to prevent it from appearing in dropdown lists. Existing transactions will not be affected.
